title: A map texture set's imported textures: res/field/maps/textures/<set>/imports.json
description: Textures of other map texture sets that this set gains, after its own, each its image and palette as the other set encodes them (tools/data/map_texture_data.py, nitro_texture_writer.py). Paper White 2's Map Editor adds them when a model moves to an area whose set lacks some of its textures; a copy of each PNG sits beside the set's own, for the editors.

texture.description: The texture's name, as the other set has it
